characters.name: Leonardo
characters.description: Disciplined blue-banded leader of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, wielding twin katanas. Calm, strategic, and protective of his brothers.

characters.name: Michelangelo
characters.description: Fun-loving orange-banded turtle with nunchaku and an energetic personality. Loves pizza, skateboarding, and making jokes.

characters.name: Donatello
characters.description: Purple-banded tech genius of the group, wielding a bo staff. Intelligent, inventive, and often building new gadgets for the team.

characters.name: Raphael
characters.description: Red-banded, strong, and rebellious turtle who fights with twin sai. Fiercely loyal but hot-headed, always ready for battle.

characters.name: Splinter
characters.description: Wise and calm mutant rat sensei who trained the turtles in ninjutsu. Acts as their father figure and mentor.

characters.name: April O'Neil
characters.description: Brave human ally of the turtles. Investigative journalist with a strong sense of justice, often assisting them in their missions.

characters.name: Casey Jones
characters.description: Vigilante ally of the turtles, known for his hockey mask and sports-equipment weapons. Tough and fearless.

characters.name: Shredder
characters.description: Armored arch-enemy of the turtles and leader of the Foot Clan. Ruthless, cunning, and skilled in martial arts.
